# mabinogi-004 — establishment log (2026-11-11)

Evans 1907 cols 27 l. 8 – 38 l. 11 (PDF pp. 46–51). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4, two crops per
column; spot crops at zoom 7–10). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised
letters into the line; line-end marks and Evans's accents dropped.

## Worklist items (31 check + 24 loss), decided on the image
All OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the witness agrees with the image (ss for ſſ/ſf, w for 6, r for
r-rotunda, k for the k-sort, li/n/m for minim clusters), confirmed one by one: col 27 ll. 8, 10, 29, 34; col 28
ll. 11, 22, 30–31 (Evans's "r" after *hynn* is a query mark, not a letter), 36 ("irwn"); col 29 ll. 2, 4, 7, 10 (a
stray mark, not a letter), 11, 14, 20, 28, 35; col 30 ll. 24, 30; col 31 ll. 1, 21, 24, 25, 28, 32, 34, 36; col 32 l. 14
("gyskeis", "doethost"), l. 20; col 33 ll. 13, 34 ("Uliant"); col 35 ll. 10, 26, 29, 30; col 36 ll. 7, 8, 23, 25;
col 37 ll. 1 ("yrdaw", r-rotunda, zoom-10 crop), 19, 21, 29; col 38 ll. 1, 5, 10.

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 32 l. 3 — Evans prints **"ýⁿagoret"** with a raised n (zoom-8 crop, certain): **"adaw y drws yn agoret"**
  ('leaving the door open'); the witness's "y agoret" drops the raised letter.
- col 34 l. 21 — Evans **"attal y mab ganthaw a gadu poen"** (singular; the witness has "ganthunt"). Kept as
  printed. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: *udunt wy … ganthaw* — 'for them … with him' (Teirnon), a shift of number in the
  sentence, as printed.
- col 34 l. 27 — Evans **"A thriphet"** (no final h; the witness "thripheth"). Kept.
- col 35 l. 11 — Evans **"Pann doethont"** (the line before has "Pan doethant"). Kept as printed.
- col 36 l. 9 — Evans **"nit adnappo uot y mab yn uab y Pwyll"** (*uot* ← *bot*); the witness's "not" is wrong.
- col 27 l. 21 — "Ac yn dryded ulwydyn": the witness's supplement "[y]" is not in the White Book and the sense does
  not need it: not supplied.

## Other spots
- col 33 l. 33 — "a glywssont": the print is faint (ſſ barely inked); the reading is the only one the traces allow.
- col 33 l. 22 — "yr ebawl": the w is faint; certain.
- col 28 l. 30 — "Och,” heb vn o'r gwraged": Evans prints *vn* (with v), kept.
- col 30 l. 33 — Evans "ar wynt ýscoet"; written "Wynt Ys Coet" as the witness (word division ours, proper name).
- col 37 l. 18 — "Teirnon Toryfliant" (Evans "tozýfliant"; elsewhere "Twryf Uliant") — kept as printed. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 38 l. 7 — "Gloyw Walltlydan" (Evans "wallt lýdan"), written as one name as the witness.
- Punctuation repairs to the witness: missing opening quotes before "ay kyscu" (col 32) and "oed escor" (col 36);
  "Yawnahaf, yw hynny" → "Yawnahaf yw hynny"; "awr.hon" → "awr hon".

No words supplied from the Red Book. Scribal forms for the drafter's notes: *vn*, *Pann/Pan doethant/doethont*,
*Toryfliant*, *ganthaw* (number shift), *diffetheeist*, *a wnaethon* (col 35, 3 pl. without -t).
